ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   C. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   B. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   C. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

9. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   C. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

14. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

16. In three clear sentences, explain My extended family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
